description: This file defines a generic grain class (`TransformGrain<TInput, TOutput>`) implementing data transformation logic in an Orleans distributed system. It manages input and output queues, processes messages asynchronously, and communicates with target grains.

classes.name: TransformGrain<TInput, TOutput>
classes.description: A generic Orleans grain class that performs transformation of input messages to output messages using a provided processor and communicates with target grains.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the grain with a specified processor for transforming input to output.

methods.name: ConsumeMessage
methods.description: Method intended to consume messages; currently not implemented.

methods.name: LinkTo
methods.description: Links this grain to a target grain to send processed messages.

methods.name: OfferMessage
methods.description: Offers a message for processing; currently not implemented.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Enqueues an input message for processing.

methods.name: SendAsync (overload)
methods.description: Enqueues an input message with a cancellation token; not implemented.

methods.name: NotifyOfPendingWork
methods.description: Starts processing input messages asynchronously if not already started.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops processing when the grain is deactivated.

methods.name: ReceiveAll
methods.description: Returns all processed output messages; currently not implemented.
